statement: A circle with center \(O\) meets a circle with center \(O'\) at \(A\) and \(B\). The common external tangent \(TT'\) touches the first circle at \(T\) and the second at \(T'\). The perpendiculars from \(T\) and \(T'\) to line \(OO'\) meet it at \(S\) and \(S'\). Ray \(AS\) meets the first circle again at \(R\), and ray \(AS'\) meets the second circle again at \(R'\). Show that \(R, B, R'\) are collinear.

Let \(N = 6^n\) where \(n\) is a positive integer, and let \(M = a^N + b^N\) where \(a, b\) are coprime integers greater than 1. Suppose \(M\) has at least two odd prime divisors greater than 1, call them \(p\) and \(q\). Find the residue of \(p^N + q^N \pmod{6 \cdot 12^n}\).

For real \(a, b\), define the sequence \(x_0, x_1, x_2, \ldots\) by \(x_0 = a\) and \(x_{n+1} = x_n + b\sin x_n\). If \(b = 1\), show that the sequence converges to a finite limit for all \(a\). If \(b > 2\), show that the sequence diverges for some \(a\).

Find the maximum value of \(\dfrac{1}{x^2} + \dfrac{2}{y^2} + \dfrac{3}{z^2}\), where \(x, y, z\) are positive reals satisfying \(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \leq z < \dfrac{\min(x\sqrt{2},\, y\sqrt{3})}{2}\), \(x + z\sqrt{3} \geq \sqrt{6}\), and \(y\sqrt{3} + z\sqrt{10} \geq 2\sqrt{5}\).
Find all real-valued continuous functions on \((-1,1)\) such that \((1-x^2)f\!\left(\dfrac{2x}{1+x^2}\right) = (1+x^2)^2 f(x)\) for all \(x\).

Let \((a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{2n})\) be a permutation of \(\{1, 2, \ldots, 2n\}\) such that \(|a_i - a_{i+1}| \neq |a_j - a_{j+1}|\) for \(i \neq j\). Show that \(a_1 = a_{2n} + n\) if and only if \(1 \leq a_{2i} \leq n\) for \(i = 1, 2, \ldots, n\).
